use default

bigrams(phrase: string) -> MAP[string, int] =>
    (let counted = MAP[string, int]()

     for word in phrase.to_lower().split([' ']) do
         for at in 0..word.length - 1 do
             let pair = word[at .. at + 2]

             counted[pair] = if counted.contains_key(pair) then
                                 counted[pair] + 1
                             else
                                 1
                             fi
         od
     od

     counted)

shared(
    left: MAP[string, int],
    right: MAP[string, int]
) -> int =>
    left
        |> filter(entry => right.contains_key(entry.key))
        |> map(entry =>
            System.Math.min(entry.value, right[entry.key]))
        |> reduce(0, (running, count) => running + count)

size(counted: MAP[string, int]) -> int =>
    counted.values |> reduce(0, (running, count) => running + count)

coefficient(
    left: MAP[string, int],
    right: MAP[string, int]
) -> double =>
    (let total = size(left) + size(right)

     if total == 0 then
         0.0D
     else
         cast double(2 * shared(left, right)) / cast(total)
     fi)

let tasks =
    IO.File.read_all_lines("rosetta-tasks.txt")
        |> map(name => (name = name, grams = bigrams(name)))
        |> collect_list()

closest(term: string) -> LIST[(name: string, score: double)] =>
    (let wanted = bigrams(term)

     let scored =
         tasks
             |> map(task =>
                 (name = task.name,
                  score = coefficient(wanted, task.grams)))
             |> collect_list()

     scored.sort((left, right) =>
         (let by_score = right.score <> left.score

          if by_score != 0 then
              by_score
          else
              left.name <> right.name
          fi))

     scored[0..5] |> collect_list())

for term in ["Primordial primes",
             "Sunkist-Giuliani formula",
             "Sieve of Euripides",
             "Chowder numbers"] do
    write_line(term)

    for (name, score) in closest(term) do
        write_line("  {score:F4}  {name}")
    od

    write_line()
od
